posts.hook: CFOs expect more FX volatility, but most cannot see exposure in real time.
posts.key_stat: 63% expect FX volatility to rise in 2026. 89% do not stress-test FX forecasts.
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card contrasting rising FX concern (63%) against the stress-testing gap (89%), reinforcing that the bottleneck is data visibility, not hedging strategy.
